quotes.text: Durante los últimos 7 días, ¿cuántas horas diarias trabajó efectivamente en su OCUPACIÓN PRINCIPAL ...[NOMBRE]...?
¿Cuántas horas semanales trabaja habitualmente en esta ocupación ...[NOMBRE]...?

assessments.reasoning: The survey instrument records hours worked in paid work and economic activities in Section 6 (e.g., Parte B, Pregunta 3 and Pregunta 6). However, it does not include questions or a time-use module recording time allocated to unpaid domestic or care work, leisure, or self-care activities. Per the indicator rule, because the instrument only records hours of paid work with no time recorded for any other daily activity, all four statements are evaluated as false.
